title: Reduce reports WebView flat exports
summary: Removed the remaining five Reports page flat WebView aliases while preserving namespace access through `window.mediaPipelineReportsView`.
reason: The active WebView cleanup workstream calls for reducing transitional flat `window.*` exports opportunistically by touched domain. Reports already exposes the affected helpers through its namespace, so app startup, command history, and browser smokes can use namespace-first access without keeping flat compatibility aliases.
behavior_before: Reports helpers were available both through `window.mediaPipelineReportsView` and five direct flat aliases: `initReportsViewEvents`, `renderFailureRows`, `renderAuditRows`, `renderAuditControls`, and `renderReportOpenHistory`. App startup, filter listeners, command history, and the Maintenance/Reports smoke still had flat-global dependencies.
behavior_after: Reports helpers remain available through `window.mediaPipelineReportsView` only. App startup, Reports filters, command history, and browser smokes use namespace-first access; the WebView public contract and global export inventory now record zero Reports flat exports.
